messages:
eli: Quick heads-up — prepping mptx-13b quant onboarding. Weights at s3://redwood-models/mptx13b/v2/ (sha a1b2c3d). Found tokenizer quirk: some inputs end up with leading space tokens -> detok drift in evals. Planning AWQ baseline + GPTQ compare. Need quick sanity check and sign-off on calib data + config.

nina: Thanks. How big is the calibration set you're planning? Also which eval prompts did you see detok drift on?

eli: Calib set: 2k samples sampled stratified by length (50%-short, 30%-mid, 20%-long). Drift mainly on long prompts with leading punctuation e.g., '\n> ' and open-quoted text. Short example: '\"What's the best way...'.

raja: For AWQ we saw ~0.6% avg LM loss bump on long tails vs float32 on previous runs; FP8 tends to add 0.8-1.2% unless we do per-channel scaling. We should run a focused long-prompt pass.

sam: Where are the exact config files? Need to review kv-path and ffn split flags. Ping me once uploaded.

eli: Configs pushed to repo branch feature/serve/mptx13b-quant -> path: infra/quant/configs/mptx13b/awq-gptq.yaml. Key flags:
```
quant_backend: awq
bits: 4
per_channel_scale: true
kv_cache: split
batching.max_tokens: 2048
```
If we change to gptq we'll toggle `quant_backend: gptq` and set `bits: 4` + `gptq_calib_iters: 512`.

taylor: Suggest running a quick canary: 500 infer samples + 1k calib samples focusing on long prompts. Can we run on dedicated dev pool? I can carve out slot PHX-dev-2 for 2 hours.

eli: thanks. I'll kick off calib job in ~20m. CI: tagging `ci-bot` to run smoke accuracy checks and push results to the dashboard.

ci-bot: Started workflow `quant-calib-smoke` for branch feature/serve/mptx13b-quant. Jobs queued on PHX-dev-2. Notifying when results available: https://ci.redwood/2149/quant-calib-smoke :robot_face:

nina: If AWQ shows <0.5% quality regression on our primary LLM eval, I'm OK with AWQ for initial canary. If >0.5% we should fallback to GPTQ or raise bits to 6 for FP8 path.

raja: Also double-check tokenizer vocab mapping; sometimes byte fallback causes off-by-one. I can run tokenizer smoke locally.

sam: Quick code review incoming for the config changes. Will approve if kv/cache flags are explicit.

eli: Perfect. I'll post the smoke results here when CI finishes. Tagging @taylor, @sam for final sign-off after the smoke.
